bug_semantics: An authenticated backend user holding any one granular Theme Editor permission could enter Cms\Controllers\Index because the controller authorization was an OR gate, while its AJAX handlers trusted the request-supplied template type and performed no permission check for that type. Such a user could open, save, create, delete, commit, or reset pages, partials, layouts, content, or assets outside the granted scope. The constructor also registered AssetList without cms.manage_assets, and its upload path lacked the theme validation used by other mutating asset handlers, permitting an otherwise unauthorized user to upload an allowed file into the active theme's assets.
flaw_origin: The public history first acquires the vulnerable authorization design in 71a5dd67ab9e0d0da7caabd3fb5aaa3d86bb45e5: that commit adds the CMS controller and AssetList, registers the distinct cms.manage_* permissions, sets the controller gate to cms.*, unconditionally constructs all per-type widgets, and implements request-type-driven handlers without a corresponding per-type authorization check. Commit 55848e400cea002491a29820e5387bce0dd44362 later replaces cms.* with an explicit five-permission list but retains hasAnyAccess OR semantics and all missing handler checks. Commit c03fd66aeb8a6f10290381a76db0867fabe881e6 later exposes the pre-existing upload-processing body as public onUpload() without adding validateRequestTheme(), extending the same access-control defect rather than originating the cross-template flaw.
ai_marker: No AI marker. `git cat-file -p 71a5dd67ab9e0d0da7caabd3fb5aaa3d86bb45e5` shows human author and committer `Sam Georges <sam@daftspunk.com>` and only the message `Welcome to the world, October :-)`; there is no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI trailer in the BIC commit object.
evidence: The assigned first-party GHSA bundle states that versions <= 1.2.12 are vulnerable and 1.2.13 is first patched; it describes the five-permission controller OR gate, missing per-template checks, unconditional AssetList registration, and missing validateRequestTheme() in onUpload().

Run `git show 71a5dd67ab9e0d0da7caabd3fb5aaa3d86bb45e5:modules/cms/controllers/Index.php` and `git show 71a5dd67ab9e0d0da7caabd3fb5aaa3d86bb45e5:modules/cms/ServiceProvider.php`: the child has `public $requiredPermissions = ['cms.*']`, separate cms.manage_pages/assets/layouts/partials/content registrations, unconditional TemplateList/AssetList construction, and handlers such as onSave/onDeleteTemplates that consume request type and mutate the resolved template without checking the permission corresponding to that type.

Run `git show 55848e400cea002491a29820e5387bce0dd44362^:modules/backend/classes/Controller.php` around line 213: controller authorization calls `hasAnyAccess($this->requiredPermissions)`, proving OR semantics. `git show 55848e400cea002491a29820e5387bce0dd44362 -- modules/cms/controllers/Index.php` shows only the gate changing from cms.* to the explicit five permissions, with handlers and unconditional widget construction left unchanged.

Provenance cross-check: `git log -L 53,59:modules/cms/controllers/Index.php 164c62524e8abc153d09c6c35916278bdb746a2b^` walks the explicit OR gate through 55848e400cea002491a29820e5387bce0dd44362 to its original cms.* line in 71a5dd67ab9e0d0da7caabd3fb5aaa3d86bb45e5. `git log --reverse -S'public $requiredPermissions = [' -- modules/cms/controllers/Index.php` and `git log --reverse -S'new AssetList' -- modules/cms/controllers/Index.php` both identify 71a5dd67ab9e0d0da7caabd3fb5aaa3d86bb45e5 as the first writer.

Immediate-parent absence is direct: `git cat-file -e d412ea685560a3ce7028346d26fd9a6559eb0827:modules/cms/controllers/Index.php` and the corresponding AssetList.php check both fail because neither path exists; the parent's modules/cms/ServiceProvider.php is only a minimal provider, and `git grep -n -e cms.manage_pages -e cms.manage_assets -e requiredPermissions d412ea685560a3ce7028346d26fd9a6559eb0827 -- modules/cms` returns no match. The child commit creates both vulnerable source files and the permission-bearing provider changes. Full `git log --all` and the -L/-S walks expose no smaller public member commit; 71a5dd67ab9e0d0da7caabd3fb5aaa3d86bb45e5 is a normal single-parent source-introduction commit, not a merge, revert, move, or identifiable squash-merge member aggregate.

Upload lifecycle: `git show c03fd66aeb8a6f10290381a76db0867fabe881e6 -- modules/cms/widgets/AssetList.php` shows `checkUploadPostback()` being renamed/exposed as public `onUpload()` and its constructor call removed, with no validateRequestTheme() added; `git grep -n validateRequestTheme c03fd66aeb8a6f10290381a76db0867fabe881e6^ -- modules/cms/widgets/AssetList.php` shows the validation on the other mutating handlers.

Fix lifecycle: `git show 164c62524e8abc153d09c6c35916278bdb746a2b -- modules/cms/controllers/Index.php modules/cms/widgets/AssetList.php` shows conditional widget registration, validateRequestType() and per-type checks on the named handlers, plus validateRequestTheme() in onUpload(). `git show 5391afa242eba3c476869035b7492e50a262c46b -- modules/cms/controllers/Index.php` adds the final validation inside makeTemplateFormWidget(); at 164c625 the index() AJAX formWidgetAlias path could still reach that helper via bindFormWidgetToController() without passing one of the newly checked handlers, so 5391afa is the closing direct fix. `git merge-base --is-ancestor 164c62524e8abc153d09c6c35916278bdb746a2b 5391afa242eba3c476869035b7492e50a262c46b` succeeds.

Version boundary: `git rev-parse v1.2.12^{commit} v1.2.13^{commit}` resolves b6ac66c5e80ddc9ecd9211c10204cdcee6e14313 and e09c8d3526f3583cb6c3476a021b885088ecd4bd. `git merge-base --is-ancestor` returns false for both 164c62524e8abc153d09c6c35916278bdb746a2b and 5391afa242eba3c476869035b7492e50a262c46b against v1.2.12, and true for both against v1.2.13. `git grep validateRequestType v1.2.12 -- modules/cms/controllers/Index.php` has no match and the tag still unconditionally constructs AssetList; v1.2.13 contains conditional cms.manage_assets registration, validateRequestType calls, helper-level validation, and onUpload theme validation. `git tag --contains 5391afa242eba3c476869035b7492e50a262c46b --sort=version:refname` begins with v1.2.13.
reasoning: The advisory mechanism is present from the repository's first public CMS implementation: granular permissions existed alongside only a section-wide OR authorization decision, while the server-side operations accepted a client-selected type. UI filtering never enforced the privilege boundary. The direct parent lacks the controller, widget, and permission registrations, and independent -L and -S history agrees on the introducing commit. Later gate wording and upload-handler refactoring preserve or extend the defect rather than create the underlying cross-type authorization failure. The April 1 patch fixes the explicit handlers and asset registration/upload, while the April 3 helper-level check closes the remaining AJAX widget-binding route; both are absent from v1.2.12 and present in v1.2.13. Because the BIC's raw commit object contains only a human identity and ordinary message with no AI/bot attribution, the vulnerability is NOT_AI regardless of any later development tooling or fix authorship.
